name: construct_information
description: Constructs two independent lists: one for required infrastructure templates and one for naming abbreviations, based on the analysis of a user's request. The two lists are not correlated. If no items for a list can be determined, an empty array should be used for that list.

templates.description: A list of resource template names required to fulfill the request. Names must match the available templates exactly.

abbreviations.description: An independent list of naming abbreviations identified in the user's request. This list has no correlation with the 'templates' list.

explanation.description: A single, concise sentence explaining why the selected templates and abbreviations were chosen based on the user's request.
